rationale: All six prior blocking findings (CR-001..CR-006) are resolved: five code findings confirmed against current source and tests, and CR-005 closed by the recorded human decision (Jira non-2xx is data on the script path only) and its implementation. 0 deferred; no new findings are discovered on a check round; brief written to code-review-brief.md.

business_review.item: Design 1: frozen ScriptRunContext flows toolkit -> tool -> service -> runner -> bridge -> channel handlers
business_review.notes: context.py, agent_workspace_service.py, job_bridge.py; test_job_bridge.py context tests

business_review.item: Design 2: registry created with script tool, filled at end of ToolkitService.get_tools; unfilled refuses
Design 3: workflow scope server-derived only, never from request
Design 4: authorizer, first match wins
Design 5: tool.call handler replaces echo, validates args_schema, uses run_for_script
Design 6: HttpResult(str) with three legacy layouts applied at Jira/Confluence/GitLab/xWiki
business_review.notes: http_result.py and four tool sites; golden tests

business_review.item: Design 7: base-class execute_structured, ScriptValueSource on HttpResult and JiraMultimodalResponse
business_review.notes: codemie_tool.py; SearchKBResponse.to_script_value added as a third source

business_review.item: Design 8: run_for_script validates config, no limit/truncation, errors logged as name/code/type only
Design 9: envelope {result, http?}; coded errors via ToolCallRefused
Design 10: 256 KiB transport bound reuses payload_too_large; ensure_ascii=False
business_review.notes: tool_call_channel.py; test_end_to_end.py boundary and non-ASCII tests

business_review.item: Design 11: log filter drops records while script_call_active is set
business_review.notes: script_call_log_guard.py, logger.py install call; sentinel tests (install itself untested, CR-001)

business_review.item: Design 12: direct REST run builds none context; script tool keeps is_safe=False
Design 13: README rewrite plus rollout checklist in README and customer-config comment
AC: tool.call returns the tool's real result; sequential calls each get their own
business_review.notes: test_end_to_end.py through real channel and SDK

business_review.item: AC: assistant run limited to the run's tool list; script tool, MCP and stream tools refused
AC: workflow run may call any user-authorized tool in the workflow's project; chat request gains nothing
business_review.notes: workflow_resolution.py; scope from _workflow_project() or workflow_project kwarg only

business_review.item: AC: script run confirmed under ask_for_approval and approve_for_me, not auto_approve; calls not confirmed individually
AC: unavailable, blocked, no-context, bad-argument and failing calls give a coded error
business_review.notes: authorizer.py, handler.py; unknown argument names are not rejected (CR-003)

business_review.item: AC: Jira/Confluence/GitLab/xWiki give parsed body and int http.status; a 404 is a normal result
business_review.notes: Jira raises on non-2xx (jira/tools.py:275,284) so 404 gives tool_failed; README admits the exception. CR-005

business_review.item: AC: pydantic model, dict, list or JSON-looking string gives JSON result with no per-tool code
AC: execute(), _run and workflow node strings byte-identical for the four HTTP tools
AC: no token limit up to transport cap; above it payload_too_large with size and limit, no content
AC: an assistant without the script tool runs no script
business_review.notes: bind_script_registries returns when no script tool is in the list

business_review.item: AC: at DEBUG no call request or result content appears in logs, including oversize path
business_review.notes: script_call_log_guard.py; sentinel tests for success, failure, oversize

standards_review.notes: all 14 commit subjects in the review range match the documented EPMCDME-####: Description format
tests/codemie_tools/base/test_http_result.py has no Apache license header (license-check --check reports it as the only missing file); new src modules otherwise typed and cohesive
no lossy decoding, credential logging or unsafe path/command construction; scope fails closed; handler logs tool name and exception type only; call logging suppressed during script calls

finding_status.notes: test_script_call_log_guard.py now asserts every real app-logger handler carries exactly one ScriptCallLogFilter and that a real app_logger record under suppress_call_logging() is not emitted; logger.py:235 install call present.
test_assistant_service_workflow_mapping.py asserts get_tools receives workflow_project == 'proj-a' for both assistant-backed and inline nodes.

handler.py _validated_kwargs refuses unknown names via extra=forbid strict schema (bad_arguments, names only), refuses args for schema-less tools and non-pydantic schemas; aliases and extra=allow schemas preserved; tests cover each and assert the tool does not run.
ScriptHttpSource protocol plus JiraMultimodalResponse.script_http(); execute_structured now emits http status/reason for image responses; golden test asserts 200/OK and the no-http-result case.

Decision recorded in fix_evidence (option a, script path only, with rationale). Implemented in jira/tools.py via execute_structured override and ContextVar-gated _raise_for_status at both call sites; tests cover GET 404, non-GET 400 and no leak into execute/_run; README updated.
test_http_result.py now begins with the full Apache header; the closing 'limitations under the License.' line is added to the src and test files named in the finding.
